title: 第13章 毒士陈平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

两汉各有一毒士，西汉陈平、东汉贾诩，啥叫“毒士”呢？就是那种专出阴毒狠辣的招式，招招要人命的人，历史上擅长使阴谋诡计的谋臣很多，但像陈平这么狠的恐怕就屈指可数了。

陈平个人品行不太好，在后世史书上更是饱受争议。司马迁在《史记·陈丞相世家》中记载其【常出奇计，救纷纠之难，振国家之患。】将其与张良并列为“谋臣典范”，但【六出奇计，世莫能闻】的批注暗指这些计策阴损，难登大雅。

宋代大儒朱熹就曾痛斥：【“陈平之术，诡矣。”】

但明末思想家王夫之辩护：【“当暴秦之后，非权谋不能立国。”】

这个被称作“毒士”的阳武书生用毕生证明，在权力的棋盘上，道德从来都是最奢侈的装饰品。正如他在临终前对汉文帝的谏言：【“宰相者，上佐天子理阴阳，下育万物之宜。至于手段清浊，且待后人评说。”】

陈平小时候出身不好，家里没啥产业，父母死的早，吃了上顿没下顿，他也没什么谋生的本事，只能跟着哥哥嫂子一起住。时间长了，嫂子不乐意了，背地里抱怨，嫌他不务正业。陈平的大哥听了，当场就发火了：“敢说我兄弟的不是，离婚！”

这事很快传成陈平在哥哥家蹭吃蹭喝，还跟嫂子有一腿，两人不清不楚的，所以他哥离婚那么坚决。一来二去，“陈平盗嫂”的谣言传得满天飞，不管陈平认不认，这锅他背定了。

无业青年陈平没啥本事，为了填饱肚子，只能在村里打零工。什么零工呢？说起来不太体面，就是给人家里办丧事的帮忙打杂，干点轻松的活儿。

陈平虽然一事无成，到处混吃混喝，却有一个优点，颜值高，长得帅气。可别小看这点，无论任何时候，漂亮的外表总能带来一些好运。

如果你认为陈平只是个长得帅的混混可就误会他了，别看他平时游手好闲、不务正业，他也是有理想有抱负的。

有一次，陈平在祭司上主持分肉，他不贪小便宜，分的很公平，大家都夸他分的好。陈平却感慨：“这算啥？有朝一日我来宰执天下，也就跟今天分肉似的。”

这番感慨让村里人对他刮目相看。有个叫张负的土豪孙女嫁了五次，五次都因为老公死了被送回娘家。村里人都认为这姑娘天生克夫，十里八乡没人敢娶。

张负很着急，有次见到陈平，被他英俊的外貌给吸引了，他自作主张将孙女许配给了他。儿子表示不服，陈平又穷又不愿劳动，全村人都笑他没出息，怎么还把孙女嫁给他呀？张负回道：“你懂什么？我看此人相貌不凡，将来必成大器！”

当然，张负也不完全是个看脸派的颜值控，他对陈平是仔细勘察过的。有一次，他曾尾随陈平到家，虽然陈平家穷得叮当响，但从他家门口各路马车的车辙印就可以断定，这家伙一定有很多达官显贵朋友，检验一个人最有效的办法是看他和什么样的人交朋友。

在张负的安排下，陈平跟孙女搭上了线。没钱娶，不要紧，我有钱，还声明以后缺钱就找丈人。在街坊邻居异样的眼神中，陈平完美克制了张家孙女的克夫命，成为了一位“耐克少年”。两人的生活如鱼得水，平安无事。

有了资金做后盾，陈平的社交圈也比之前扩大了不少。很快，他已经不甘心待在这个小地方，准备出去做一番大事业。

几年后，陈胜带头起义，陈平的家乡很快被卷入战争。为了混出个模样，陈平投奔了魏王魏咎，希望可以在那里发挥自己的专业特长。

魏咎很看重陈平，给他封了个太仆。刚开始，陈平还觉得不错，可惜没过多久，魏国内斗，搞得陈平无法安心工作。陈平觉得再待下去没啥前途，又投奔了项羽，跟着项羽一路西进。由于表现突出，被项羽赐予爵位，位比公卿。

本来形势一片大好，可后来项羽因分封引发了诸多人的不满，天下很快又陷入动荡之中，项羽疲于四处平乱。

Each Han Dynasty had its own poisonous scholar, Chen Ping in the Western Han Dynasty and Jia Xu in the Eastern Han Dynasty. What are "poison scholars" called?It's the kind of person who specializes in vicious and ruthless tactics to recruit people who want to kill people. There are many counselors in history who are good at making plots, but there are probably only a handful of them as ruthless as Chen Ping.

Chen Ping's personal conduct was not very good, and he was even more controversial in later history books.Sima Qian recorded in "Historical Records: The Family of Prime Minister Chen" that he often came up with strange plans to save the country from troubles and troubles.] listed him as a "model counselor" along with Zhang Liang, but the annotation "Six Unexpected Strategies, Unknown to the World" implies that these strategies are sinister and difficult to be refined.

Zhu Xi, a great scholar in the Song Dynasty, once denounced: "Chen Ping's technique is weird."

However, Wang Euzhi, a thinker in the late Ming Dynasty, defended: "After the Qin Dynasty was overthrown, a country cannot be established without power and strategy."]

This Yangwu scholar, known as the "Poison Man", spent his life proving that on the chessboard of power, morality has always been the most luxurious decoration.Just as he advised Emperor Wen of the Han Dynasty before his death: "The prime minister assists the emperor in regulating yin and yang, and educates all things appropriately. As for whether the means are pure or dirty, let future generations comment."

When Chen Ping was a child, he had a poor background. His family had little property, his parents died early, and he had no ability to make a living. He had no choice but to live with his brother and sister-in-law.As time passed, my sister-in-law became dissatisfied and complained behind her back that he was not doing his job properly.When Chen Ping's eldest brother heard this, he got angry on the spot: "If you dare to say anything wrong about my brother, get a divorce!"

This incident soon spread that Chen Ping was eating and drinking at his brother's house, and was having an affair with his sister-in-law. The two of them didn't know each other, so his brother was so determined to divorce.Over time, rumors of "Chen Ping stealing his wife" spread all over the place. Whether Chen Ping admitted it or not, he was definitely responsible for it.

Chen Ping, an unemployed young man, has no skills. In order to fill his stomach, he can only do odd jobs in the village.What odd jobs?It's not very respectable to say, but I just do some light work to help people who are organizing funerals.

Although Chen Ping has accomplished nothing and is eating and drinking everywhere, he has one advantage: he is good-looking and handsome.Don't underestimate this, good appearance can always bring some good luck at any time.

If you think Chen Ping is just a handsome gangster, you have misunderstood him. Even though he is usually idle and not doing his job properly, he also has ideals and ambitions.

Once, Chen Ping presided over the sharing of meat at the priest. He was not greedy for petty advantages and divided the meat fairly. Everyone praised him for his good sharing.But Chen Ping sighed: "What does this mean? One day I come to rule the world, it will be like dividing the meat today."

This emotion made the villagers look at him with admiration.There was a wealthy granddaughter named Zhang Fu who was married five times and was sent back to her parents' home five times because her husband died.Everyone in the village believed that this girl was born to be a coward, and no one from far away would dare to marry her.

Zhang Fu was very anxious. Once he met Chen Ping and was attracted by his handsome appearance. He took it upon himself to betroth his granddaughter to him.The son expressed his dissatisfaction. Chen Ping was poor and unwilling to work. The whole village laughed at him for being hopeless. Why did he marry his granddaughter to him?Zhang Fu replied: "What do you know? I think this man has extraordinary looks and will become a great person in the future!"

Of course, Zhang Huan is not exactly a person who cares about appearance. He has carefully investigated Chen Ping.Once, he followed Chen Ping home. Although Chen Ping's family was very poor, it could be concluded from the ruts of carriages in front of his house that this guy must have many high-ranking friends. The most effective way to test a person is to see what kind of people he makes friends with.

Under Zhang Fu's arrangement, Chen Ping got in touch with his granddaughter.It doesn't matter if I don't have money to marry, I have money, and I also declared that if I need money in the future, I will find my husband-in-law.In the strange eyes of his neighbors, Chen Ping perfectly overcame the fate of the Zhang family's granddaughter and became a "Nike boy."The two of them lived a peaceful and peaceful life.

With the financial support, Chen Ping's social circle has expanded a lot than before.Soon, he was no longer willing to stay in this small place and was ready to go out and do something big.

A few years later, Chen Sheng led the uprising, and Chen Ping's hometown was soon involved in the war.In order to make a name for himself, Chen Ping defected to Wei Jiu, the king of Wei, hoping to use his professional expertise there.

Wei Jiu valued Chen Ping very much and made him a royal servant.At first, Chen Ping thought it was good. Unfortunately, not long after, the internal strife in Wei made Chen Ping unable to work with peace of mind.Chen Ping felt that there was no future for him to stay any longer, so he defected to Xiang Yu again and followed Xiang Yu all the way westward.Due to his outstanding performance, he was awarded a title by Xiang Yu and was ranked as a minister.

The situation was originally very good, but later Xiang Yu caused dissatisfaction among many people due to his enfeoffment. The world soon fell into turmoil again, and Xiang Yu was tired of quelling the chaos everywhere.
